framework_overview.description: This guide outlines 8 distinct but interconnected growth levers that drive penetration growth for Barilla. Each lever represents a strategic area of commercial excellence and can be used to unify consumer marketing, trade marketing, e-commerce, and sales toward building brands profitably. The levers encourage holistic thinking, from assessing past performance to setting strategic and annual plans, and ongoing performance tracking. Underpinning all 8 levers is profit optimization, ensuring that each lever is deployed sustainably and profitably.

demand_creation.focus: Building a strong brand over time, increasing relevance and reputation.
demand_creation.goal: Ensuring the brand comes to mind when consumers consider purchases, standing out from competitors.
demand_creation.key_point: People must be able to recognize the brand, attach meaning to it, and place it in their mental shortlist.

demand_conversion.focus: Turning latent demand into actual purchases (triggering current sales).
demand_conversion.goal: Making the brand available in the right channels, formats, with compelling visibility and purchase triggers.
demand_conversion.key_point: Activities should maximize return while ensuring availability, ease of purchase, and strong presence.

profit_optimisation.importance: Ensures sustainability of any demand creation or conversion efforts by delivering value (profit or market share).
profit_optimisation.responsibility: Not solely finance; every commercial marketing role impacts sales, revenue, and profits. Building brand profitably is a collective responsibility.

lever_1_strong_brand_foundations.focus: The power of a brand derived from its positioning, recognizability, shelf impact, and consumer presence. Also includes consumer creative approach.
lever_1_strong_brand_foundations.rationale: Clear, compelling brand foundations ensure meaningfulness, difference, and salience, driving brand power and penetration.

brand_foundations.definition: What we want the brand to stand for in people’s hearts and minds, offering compelling benefits that connect emotionally and align with consumer values.

kantar_key_characteristics.meaningfulness: Meeting people’s needs and being liked.

key_elements.brand_power_score: The combination of meaningfulness, difference, and salience. Increasing Brand Power is the ultimate goal of this lever.

benefits_of_strong_brand_foundations: Capture more volume by attracting new users.
Gain a larger share of value in the market.
lever_1_strong_brand_foundations.collaboration_with_agencies: Essential to firmly establish brand foundations and bring them to life via breakthrough ideas and campaigns.

ehrenberg_bass_research.distinctive_assets: Shapes, colors, sounds, fonts, packaging, endorsements, etc.
ehrenberg_bass_research.importance: Continuously reinforce these unique brand elements to ensure easy recognition on shelf and memorability.

lever_2_superior_products.focus: Ensuring both perceived and actual product quality are superior (or at least equal) to competition.

rationale.product_superiority_importance: A key driver of market performance, influencing brand premium potential, loyalty, and word-of-mouth.
rationale.superiority_builds_equity: Demonstrating credible, superior product performance increases the likelihood that consumers will choose our brand over competitors.

key_principles: Superiority must be believable and proven through credible 'Reasons to Believe' (RTBs).
Product or packaging upgrades, recipe renovations, or sustainability initiatives can refresh a brand’s ability to deliver high quality.
Delighting consumers with great taste, quality, and sustainable sourcing drives repeat purchase and loyalty.
Continuous improvement of the brand experience secures both short and long-term brand success.
what_to_measure: North Star KPI: Product Advisor Score

lever_3_incremental_innovation.focus: Driving brand portfolio expansion by introducing meaningful innovations that create new usage occasions, attract new consumers, or trade up value.
lever_3_incremental_innovation.key_statement: Brands perceived to be meaningfully different and demonstrate innovative behaviors grow at double the rate of those that are meaningfully different alone.

rationale.innovation_as_growth_driver: Innovation keeps brands relevant to new audiences or sustains the brand’s role among existing consumers, adding incremental value rather than duplicating current offerings.
rationale.meaningful_difference: Ensures incremental (vs. cannibalized) volume by genuinely introducing something new—whether in product, packaging, or usage occasion.

examples_of_application: Repositioning products for new usage occasions
what_to_measure: North Star KPI: Nielsen | Innovation Impact measure

lever_4_activation_at_scale.focus: Covers all commercial activation, bridging Demand Creation and Demand Conversion. Ensures integrated marketing, trade, and sales activities in and out of store for optimal impact.

rationale.brand_building_and_sales_activation: Brand activation involves both long-term brand-building (investing in mental availability) and short-term promotional bursts (driving immediate transactions). The most effective campaigns combine both.
rationale.omnichannel_coordination: Activities must be coordinated across the entire path to purchase—digital and physical—covering e-commerce, retail media, in-store displays, etc.

examples_of_application: Digital marketing (social, search, content, CRM, programmatic, etc.)

lever_5_right_assortment.focus: Maximize effectiveness of the assortment range in each store type by adapting to shopper needs and prioritizing lead selling SKUs.

rationale.shopper_missions_and_sku_availability: Shoppers often have a specific product in mind. Missing SKUs lead to lost sales and can impact brand loyalty. The right formats and sizes must align with each store environment’s shopper missions.

examples_of_application: New SKU (size, weight, format) primary and secondary placement
Non-promotional brand packs tied in with brand portfolio
Upsized / downsized packs to meet specific store needs

lever_6_availability_and_visibility.focus: Covers the two most important drivers of physical availability: being present in distribution (availability) and ensuring high visibility and impactful displays (off-shelf displays).

rationale.core_principle: Even if demand is created, if products are not readily available or visible, the potential sale will be lost.
rationale.physical_availability_impact: Optimizing availability and visibility ensures that shoppers can easily find and choose the product, converting latent demand into actual purchase.

examples_of_application: Initiatives to build distribution coverage in key retail channels
Secondary placements (off-shelf, gondola ends, promotional aisles)
Placement of Point of Purchase material (signage, stands)
Display set-ups in online and offline channels

lever_7_integrated_pricing_and_promotion.focus: Create a positive perception of value compared to competitors (including private label) while maintaining brand equity and profitability.

rationale.pricing_promotion_impact: Pricing and promotions are straightforward levers to drive penetration. Mismanagement can erode margins or damage brand image. Balancing affordability with brand equity is crucial.
rationale.profitability_balance: Optimizing price structures and promotional mechanics helps attract new and existing consumers without compromising profitability or diluting brand positioning.

examples_of_application: Money-off coupons (online and offline) and redemption tracking
Cross-brand multipacks for new usage occasions
Bundled price promotions in-aisle or cross-category

what_to_measure.north_star_kpi: No promo average price / Net Revenue Management (NRM)

lever_8_win_win_partnerships.focus: Build triple-win partnerships (consumer, customer, Barilla) with key retailers to drive category growth, brand preference, and share development profitably.

rationale.mutual_benefit: Retailers control shelf access and consumer reach. Collaborative strategies that focus on category growth and brand preference help both Barilla and the retailer succeed.
rationale.shared_value_creation: Aligning brand initiatives with retailer objectives leverages co-marketing, promotions, and distribution efficiencies for greater collective impact.

growth_measures: Category value growth in key retailers

brand_building_blend.guiding_statement: Evidence suggests the following blend for the most effective brand-building:
long_term_focus: Reaching a broad base of new people
short_term_focus: Increasing occasions and spend among existing users
brand_building_blend.overall_note: Execute creatively, simply, and integrate across multiple channels to ensure share of voice exceeds share of market.
